permit_only_if: session audience is carr-control-room-web or the principal is a registered non-browser identity
agent principal and runtime principal are active and mapped to a Control Room role
tenant is derived from the authenticated principal and environment is derived from typed server context
human sponsor and personal brain scope are independently resolved or the session is explicitly unsponsored and task-scoped
capability is explicit, unexpired, and not revoked
exact resource and environment are server allowed
global read-only kill switch permits mutation

joe_owner_production_approver.R2: create and triage requests and evidence candidates
joe_owner_production_approver.R4: approve typed high-consequence record actions after re-authentication
joe_owner_production_approver.R5: approve exact production plan hash after re-authentication; browser never executes
joe_owner_production_approver.R6: review only; send in owning outbound system

dell_reporter_viewer.R0: read safe health, requests, incidents, releases, and authorized audit summaries
dell_reporter_viewer.R2: create and refine requests and evidence candidates

doc_system_desk.R2: create candidate requests, plans, and redacted evidence

codex_or_claude_code.R0: read only within parent request scope
codex_or_claude_code.R5: repo work only; no Control Room approval or browser execution

service_identity.R2: submit idempotent evidence for one named job
service_identity.R5: dedicated executor may invoke one registered actuator after broker validation

identity_dimensions.sponsoring_human_id: verified Joe or Dell sponsor, or null for unattended work
identity_dimensions.partner_id: canonical partner identity equal to the verified sponsor, or null
identity_dimensions.runtime_principal: authenticated runtime instance and credential class
identity_dimensions.session_capability_profile: server-issued exact capabilities, resources, environment, expiry, and grant version
identity_dimensions.personal_brain_scope: joe or dell only when derived from that verified sponsor; explicit none for authenticated unsponsored work; null only for unresolved expected sponsorship
identity_dimensions.personal_brain_version_and_count: resolved connector/render version and count; missing scope is Unknown, not successful zero
identity_dimensions.independence: Tenant, sponsor, agent, runtime, capability, and brain scope are validated separately. No personal rule or caller field may choose or widen another dimension.

human_workspace_dimensions.company_shape: CARR has more than 150 human real estate agents operating as solo agents or members of explicit team workspaces.
human_workspace_dimensions.human_user_id: verified individual identity; team work never uses a shared login
human_workspace_dimensions.seat_status: licensed authentication and module entitlement only; no business-data authority
human_workspace_dimensions.active_workspace_id: server-derived workspace context for one request, screen, job, search, Doc interaction, or Hermes operation
human_workspace_dimensions.workspace_membership_id: current explicit membership binding the human to the active solo-agent or team workspace
human_workspace_dimensions.workspace_role: role inside one workspace; never inherited from company-tenant administration
human_workspace_dimensions.resource_visibility: private_user, workspace, exact explicit_share, or intentionally promoted corporate_shared
human_workspace_dimensions.grant_rule: effective access is the intersection of active seat, exact active workspace membership, workspace role, module entitlement, resource and field policy, purpose, environment, session freshness, and revocation state
human_workspace_dimensions.administration_rule: tenant seat administration has no automatic access to business records; any compliance or supervisory view is separately purpose-bound, minimum-field, and audited
human_workspace_dimensions.runtime_rule: Doc or Hermes receives the exact human and workspace context from the server and cannot widen it through prompts, memory, jobs, URLs, or payload fields

platform_administration.scope: platform code, intellectual property, tenant provisioning, licensing, release governance, and platform-wide controls

tenant_administration.scope: the single CARR tenant only; future seat licenses may grant narrow tenant-local capabilities without platform ownership
tenant_administration.customer_delegable: only by Joe through an owner-controlled typed grant after implementation approval

authority_planes.phase0: Both administration capabilities are modeled but no administration route or grant exists in Phase 0.

conditions: not exposed by Phase 0 read API

explicit_denies.reason: Phase 0 has no mutation, approval, grant, execution, or external-effect route.
Dell launches as Reporter/Viewer for system operations.
An agent or service identity cannot approve or grant itself authority.

An unattended or unsponsored agent receives active shared rules and/or explicit job-scoped rules, reports personal scope none with count zero, cannot claim a human sponsor, and is never eligible for a humanOnly verb or capability.
Personal brain scope must equal the verified sponsoring partner. A foreign or caller-selected personal scope is denied without rule bodies or foreign metadata.
Personal rules may shape a sponsored session but cannot select tenant, sponsor, agent, runtime, role, risk, capability, resource, environment, expiry, or promote themselves to shared scope.
No Production approval or execution on phone or iPad initially.
Joe retains platform and intellectual-property control; a tenant or corporate customer may license seats but cannot become platform owner or administrator.

R0.name: Observe
R0.gate: authenticated scoped read with declared redaction and freshness; no approval

R2.name: Additive low-consequence
R2.gate: exact target, schema validation, idempotency key, and audit; agents create candidates only

R3.name: Material operating change
R3.gate: fresh base version, old/new diff, human confirmation, event, and compensation path

R4.name: High-consequence record change
R4.gate: authorized human, recent re-authentication, typed target and provenance, second acknowledgement when irreversible or cross-owner

R5.name: Control plane
R5.gate: Joe approves immutable exact plan revision and hash after re-authentication; dedicated executor uses registered actuator after rehearsal and rollback readiness

R6.name: External effect
R6.gate: no Control Room execution route; outbound goes through Joe's own accounts when Joe asks (decision 41906a30)
